classification_scope: Unique on the continuation domain where either exact constraints already make A singleton or, for A={0,1}, one previous branch bit h is supplied and straightness continuation is imposed.

covariance.coordinate_permutation: PROVED in donor-relation representation; the rule repeats the previous relation rather than privileging a coordinate name.
covariance.global_inversion: PROVED at transfer-relation/vector level; inversion transports both current and memory relations.
covariance.transverse_exchange: PROVED for the partial selector under A->1-A and h->1-h.

local_signature: A(s) subseteq {0,1}, the exact legal Boolean solution set after completion-neighbor legality and all exact local/upstream algebraic constraints.
tau_action: tau A={1-b:b in A}; on memory h, tau h=1-h.
truth_table_role: Tiny truth-table enumeration may verify the four one-bit Boolean functions but is not the theorem mechanism.
